nodes.title: 01 萌娘立绘 · 固定站姿

generation.prompt:
游戏角色独立全身立绘，精致二次元日系卡通赛璐璐插画，可爱的成年猫耳魔法少女，奶油金色长发与蓬松猫耳，清澈琥珀色眼睛，温柔浅笑，深海军蓝与象牙白学院魔法裙装，金色星月饰品，白色过膝袜与深蓝短靴，服装完整得体。人物正面略向右侧身约15度，脸朝向观众，双脚稳稳落地，重心自然放在一条腿，另一腿微松但不迈步；画面左侧的一只手在腰部高度轻握一根竖直的细长金色月牙法杖，杖底着地，另一只手自然轻放在腰前，不挥手，不做攻击姿势。法杖顶端是简洁月牙与蓝色宝石，无发光粒子。所有头发、耳朵、法杖顶端、双脚完整可见，人物与法杖占画面高度约80%，四周尤其上下各留10%纯色安全空间。单个人物，细腻干净线稿与柔和明暗，清晰稳定轮廓，正交平视固定构图。背景必须是均匀纯洋红色#FF00FF，无渐变、地面、投影、场景、文字、边框、水印；角色和服装不使用洋红色。不做拼图，不要多视图。

游戏素材约束：单个主体、完整不裁切、四周保留动作空间；背景均匀纯色；不出现地面、地砖、站台、展示台、底座、台阶、接触阴影、投影、反射、文字、Logo、水印或其他角色。

nodes.title: 02 轻呼吸 Idle · 5秒

generation.prompt: Animate this exact anime character illustration as a very subtle living portrait idle loop lasting 5 seconds. Preserve the exact reference standing pose, character design, face, outfit, staff, full-body framing and scale. The character stays planted on the same two feet, with the staff tip fixed and both hands holding their original positions throughout. Only a tiny relaxed breathing rise and fall of the upper torso and shoulders, barely perceptible slow body sway, and delicate secondary motion in the hair tips and loose fabric. One slow complete breathing cycle over the full 5 seconds, smoothly returning to the starting pose and hair position at the end for a seamless loop. Keep the soft smile, eyes looking toward the viewer and mouth closed. The character is calmly standing, not performing any action. Motion amplitude below one percent of character height. Locked camera, no zoom, pan, tilt or rotation. Preserve full body and staff inside the frame with stable margins. Keep the background uniformly solid magenta #FF00FF at every frame, no scenery, floor, shadows or effects. No walking, stepping, bouncing, waving, gestures, attacks, staff swinging, turning, exaggerated swaying, speaking, transformation, extra limbs, extra characters, flicker or cuts. Gentle minimal movement is intentional; never amplify it into an action animation.
